Sam

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works schedule-wise. Procurement is asking for the final amount today so they can open the PO. Are we using the $38,880 you sent over chat, or should I wait for the revised PDF?

segments.text:

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text:

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
Got it. I added PO-44719 to the billing notes and flagged net 30. Once you sign, I’ll send the kickoff checklist and the data import template.

segments.text:

segments.text:
